title: EnderPocket
description: 📦 Open your Ender Chest from anywhere in seconds.
body:
# 📦 EnderPocket

Remote Ender Chest access for cleaner survival and admin workflows.

## ? What You Get
- Main command: `/enderpocket`
- Lightweight architecture with no hard dependencies
- OP/admin update checker in chat with direct version link

## ? Compatibility
- Java 17+
- Paper / Spigot / Purpur / Folia / Bukkit
- Minecraft 1.20+

## ? Support
- https://buymeacoffee.com/perusi
